stem: Which statement about Child Wellbeing Unit pathways is correct?

options.text: The Child Wellbeing Unit accepts all Risk of Significant Harm reports at any time of day or night
The Child Protection Unit is the same service as FaCS and is the main destination for statutory reports
The Child Wellbeing Unit operates within work hours, and Health, Education, and Police have their own units
E-report forms are intended only for imminent Risk of Significant Harm situations
The Child Wellbeing Unit only deals with single-incident concerns and not accumulative risk

explanation: The Child Wellbeing Unit operates during work hours, and Health, Education, and Police each have their own units. It can receive concerns that do not meet the threshold for significant risk and can consider accumulative risk of harm.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

rationale: The Child Wellbeing Unit is an office-hours pathway for concerns that still require child protection attention.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because Risk of Significant Harm reports go to the Child Protection Helpline rather than the Child Wellbeing Unit.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the Child Protection Unit is different from FaCS.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because the Child Wellbeing Unit operates within work hours, and Health, Education, and Police each have their own units.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because e-report forms can be used for non-imminent suspected Risk of Significant Harm reports.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the Child Wellbeing Unit can consider accumulative risk of harm and is not limited to single-incident concerns.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
